items.reason: A gentle, active-free cleanser keeps the base of your routine simple while you introduce new actives.
A gentle morning active that suits an oily-labelled skin and helps skin look balanced and less shiny.
A starter-strength retinol for nights, a beginner-friendly way to support smoother-looking, more even skin over time.
A lightweight ceramide moisturizer supports a comfortable skin barrier and your moisture score while the retinol settles in.
Daily mineral SPF 50 is essential alongside retinol and helps protect your already even-looking tone.

response.routine_note: Mornings: cleanser, niacinamide, moisturizer, then SPF. Nights: cleanser, retinol on just 2 nights a week at first (building up slowly as skin feels comfortable), then moisturizer, and stop the retinol and check with a professional if you become pregnant or start breastfeeding.
